title: Migration Act 1978 (Chapter 16)
topic: entry and stay; removal; detention; refugees
amended: Migration (Amendment) Acts No. 15 of 1982, No. 10 of 1989 and No. 15 of 1996 (as noted in this copy); later amendments not shown
source_tier: UN-hosted copy (UNODC SHERLOC), not a government site
note: Consolidated text with amendment footnotes up to 1996; the certification date is blank. Entry only with an entry permit (s. 3, replaced 1996); conditions of entry and cancellation with a Committee of Review (ss. 5-6); unlawful presence (s. 7); removal orders and power to detain and remove (ss. 12-13); carrier duties (s. 15). Inserted in 1989: the Minister may decide that a non-citizen is a refugee (s. 15A), declare relocation centres (s. 15B) and direct a refugee or asylum claimant to live in one, with police power to detain and use force (s. 15C). No appeal against decisions of the Minister (s. 19). Offences carry a fine of up to K5,000 or six months in prison (s. 16). Later amendments, including the 2014-2015 changes tied to the Manus Island centre after the Supreme Court decision in Namah v Pato (2016), are not in this copy: find the current consolidated text on PacLII or from the Immigration and Citizenship Authority.
